entities.summary: A parliamentary republic is a republic that operates under a parliamentary system of government where the executive branch derives its legitimacy from and is accountable to the legislature. Both executive and legislative powers are ultimately held within the parliament as most commonly the government is a subset of the members of the parliament. parliamentary republic is a form of government. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 76 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
